name: Clip Export
author: zysilm
punchline: Cut part of a video into a new file: a lossless stream copy or a re-encoded MP4
description:
Exports part of the local video playing as a new file, from a sidebar tab, Clip Export. Fast copies the streams (lossless, about as fast as the disk, from the keyframe at or before the start); Precise re-encodes an MP4 from the exact frame, with a quality preset or your own settings, and can include the video effects and burned-in subtitles. Set the range by typing it, with Now, from the A-B loop, or export the last 10–120 seconds with one key. The range shows on the seek bar while the tab is open; running exports show their progress, and the last twenty clips stay in Results.
The Collection page gathers ranges from several local files into one list: reorder it, remove parts, preview a part with a double click, and export them as one merged video (Fast when the files match, Precise otherwise).
Video ▸ Export Clip… opens the tab.
